'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Jim Li LS Dantooine Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jim Li]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Dantooine Base Operations / More Dangerous Than You Realize|SE-L-dantooinebaseoperations.gif}}
* '''Username:''' jim li
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
